newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac says pref issue remains an option.
newsitem.headline: Westpac says pref issue remains an option.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp, responding to an article in the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper, said on Thursday it retained an option over an underwriting agreement for a A$500 million converting preference share issue.

The bank said the option was put in place in May this year to cover any equity funding needs that might arise out of its planned takeover of Bank of Melbourne Ltd, which involves a mixture of shares and cash.
"Westpac has never indicated to the market that CPS issuance would be a definite element of the merger funding plan," it said.

"The original statement in the half year profit announcement made clear that the underwriting commitment would only be used if '... increased Tier 1 capital (was) required as a result of the merger'."
The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said the preference share issue had been abandonded. It said the underwriting deal was with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in May.
